sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fp.posting_key) FROM fct_posting fp JOIN posting_skills ps1 ON fp.posting_key = ps1.posting_key JOIN posting_skills ps2 ON fp.posting_key = ps2.posting_key JOIN dim_skill ds1 ON ps1.skill = ds1.skill JOIN dim_skill ds2 ON ps2.skill = ds2.skill WHERE fp.is_open = TRUE AND fp.remote_us = TRUE AND fp.is_canonical_listing = TRUE AND ds1.skill = 'Python' AND ds2.skill = 'SQL'
